def test_there_are_zero_live_canonicalization_call_sites() -> None:
    callers = []
    declarers = []
    for path in sorted(APP_DIR.rglob("*.py")):
        if path == MODULE:
            continue
        source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for marker in ("canonicalize(", "CanonicalizationResult("):
            if marker in source:
                callers.append(f"{path.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)}:{marker}")
        if "canonicalization_version" in source:
            declarers.append(str(path.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)))
    assert callers == ["app/execution/binding_projection.py:canonicalize(", "app/execution/pipeline.py:canonicalize("], f"canonicalization invoked in production code: {callers}"
    from tests.execution.pipeline_contract_support import assert_budget
    assert_budget("canonicalize")
    # The field name may only appear where a passive contract type declares it as
    # a field: P0 types, P1 audit, the P4 confirmation record, which stores it so
    # an approval can be compared against the version that produced the arguments
    # (RISK_REGISTER R-07), and the P5 dispatcher, which checks it is present
    # before any authority is read (INV-006). None of the four calls the
    # canonicalizer; the invariant this file protects is untouched.
    assert declarers == [
        "app/execution/audit_events.py",
        "app/execution/confirmation.py",
        "app/execution/dispatch.py",
        "app/execution/pipeline.py",
        "app/execution/types.py",
    ], declarers
